messages.snippet: Richard, Grace, Before we send our counter to Drummond Hale: we propose conceding the March 2026 lev
messages.subject: Project Mallory — our counter mark-up before sending to Sterling
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard, Grace,

Before we send our counter to Drummond Hale: we propose conceding the March 2026 leverage covenant at 5.00x (your forecast supports it) in exchange for holding the margin uplift at 185bps (4.35%) and the amendment fee at 0.85% (£357,000), down from Sterling's 200bps/£420k. Net annual interest saving against their ask is roughly £65k. Are you content for us to send on this basis?

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000

messages.subject: RE: Project Mallory — A&R agreement (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
Olivia,

Our counter is attached. We accept the March 2026 net leverage covenant at 5.00x. In return we've set the margin uplift at 185bps (4.35%) and the amendment fee at 0.85% (£357,000). Given the £2m equity injection and the turnaround commitment, we think this is the right landing zone. Subject to this we can target signing on 27 February.

James
